subject: Offline delivery timeline and go/no-go checks
body:
Message 1
From: Jeffrey Park <j.park@opsops.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offline delivery timeline and go/no-go checks

Hannah,

We're lining up the physical delivery for the air-gapped image bundle the week of Apr 19. OpsOps needs to lock down an acceptance window and the exact go/no-go checklist so the courier can be cleared for the secure drop and operator activation. High-level asks:
- Proposed courier ETA (local site): Apr 20, 09:00-12:00 PT
- Who signs on acceptance? (name + role)
- Required signed artifacts (manifest, signer roster, chain-of-custody)
- Emergency rollback authority and contact

Attached: delivery_manifest.csv (csv stub), signer_roster.pdf (stub).

Can you confirm the acceptance window and the go/no-go criteria by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Jeffrey Park
Program Manager, OpsOps Inc.
j.park@opsops.com

---

Message 2
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jeffrey Park <j.park@opsops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offline delivery timeline and go/no-go checks

Jeffrey — thanks for the heads up. The proposed ETA looks feasible. Below is Redwood's acceptance & go/no-go matrix for the drop: please share with your courier and on-site operator.

Acceptance window (target): Apr 20, 09:00-11:00 PT
Pre-drop (T-72h): manifest + signer roster due to redwood-security@redwoodinference.com
On-site acceptance (T-0):
  - Visual match of sealed tamper-evident crate labels to manifest
  - Signer roster checked against on-device certs (see S1)
  - HSM-wrapped key envelope present and sealed (S2)
  - Operator badge & delegated-access form signed in person

Go/no-go checklist (itemize):
  1) Crate seals intact and match manifest labels
  2) All signer certificates valid and present (no expired certs)
  3) HSM envelope integrity verified and KMS thumbprint matches pre-shared hash
  4) On-site network air-gap verification: no active external NICs connected before activation
  5) Backup offline rollback bundle present and validated on-site (offline checksum OK)

Rollback authority: Hannah Schmitt (Director, Private Deployments) — primary
Secondary: Karthik Iyer (Engineering Manager)
Emergency contacts: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

Notes/attachments: delivery_manifest.csv, signer_roster.pdf (from OpsOps). We'll also attach our internal KMS integration notes and a short HSM acceptance checklist. Please confirm courier ETA and whether the courier can deliver a signature capture (physical).

-Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com

Message 3
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Jeffrey Park <j.park@opsops.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offline delivery timeline and go/no-go checks

Short technical detail set for the on-site team — please circulate to the operator:

1) Pre-drop hashes: OpsOps should provide SHA256 hashes for the signed bundle and the HSM-wrapped key envelope two business days prior to delivery. Redwood will publish the verification hashes to the secure acceptance mailbox.
2) KMS/HSM expectations: HSM envelope must be wrapped with customer-specific KEK; our on-site operator will not unwrap without dual-auth (operator + remote approval token). If OpsOps is handling the chain-of-custody, confirm that the KEK fingerprint is included in the signer_roster.pdf.
3) Network isolation test: the operator must boot to a staging console that performs NIC state audit. NICs must be administratively down and the staging console must show zero external routes before installation begins.
4) Offline rollback: maintain a separate, sealed backup crate labelled ROLLBACK-<site-id>. The backup bundle must contain a signed activation manifest and a script to revert to previous image (hash included).

Attachment: kms-integration-notes.md (text stub). The only items that will block a go are mismatched hashes or missing HSM envelope. Minor issues (e.g., courier paperwork errors) can be remediated on-site but must be recorded.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Engineering Manager, Private Deployments
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Message 4
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jeffrey Park <j.park@opsops.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offline delivery timeline and go/no-go checks

Reviewed the proposed acceptance matrix — a few mandatory additions from security/audit:

- Audit retention: On-site operator must capture a signed chain-of-custody PDF and transfer the record to Redwood's SCIM mailbox within 24 hours. We will ingest to our internal evidence store for 90 days by default (longer retention is a contractual option).
- HSM key rotation: For this deployment we require a pre-delivery KEK rotation certificate dated within the last 30 days. No exceptions.
- Operator identity verification: require government ID + company badge; photo of signer next to sealed crate (stored in offline evidence bundle).
- Crypto validation step: operator must calculate hash locally and read the first 8 bytes aloud while the on-site witness confirms (record in acceptance notes).

I've attached signed_ack.docx (stub) that we require the on-site operator to sign and return.

If OpsOps cannot meet the KEK rotation requirement we will need to delay by one week to accommodate a rotation cycle.

-Mina
Mina Haddad
Lead Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com

Thanks everyone — we can meet the requirements. Quick confirmations:
- Courier ETA: Apr 20, 09:00-10:30 PT (local site).
- KEK rotation certificate: can provide within 48 hours (we'll email to redwood-security@redwoodinference.com).
- Courier will have signature capture and will print a physical chain-of-custody. Photo capture is supported but subject to site rules — we'll confirm site allowance upfront.

Attached: courier_manifest.pdf.

Hannah — we authorize you as primary rollback authority for this activation. Please escalate to Karthik if you issue a stop/rollback order — OpsOps will comply and hold the crate.

I'll circulate the pre-drop hashes by Apr 18 COB.

Jeffrey Park
